item.title: Markets can no longer ignore the war
item.description: Oil prices approach $100 per barrel, and diesel futures hit record highs, signaling market impacts from the conflict.

item.title: Older adults now outnumber young children for the first time
item.description: According to U.S. Census Bureau data, people aged 65 and older now outnumber children aged 5 and under globally.

item.title: Brain implants become new front in U.S.-China tech competition
item.description: Devices like Neuralink's are emerging as a key area of contention between the U.S. and China in bioscience.

item.title: Alaska balances oil ambitions with climate change realities
item.description: Alaska faces a paradox: melting glaciers draw tourists while the state pushes for more oil development.
